page.overview:
Who is Baff Baksheen?

Baff Baksheen was an alien smuggler who was in possesion of the Luovian Gauntlet during the New Republic Era.

Baff Baksheen made his debut in the first issue of the comic book series Star Wars: Doctor Aphra – Chaos Agent,
